mapper.select: SELECT USER_KEY AS userKey, USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, USER_EMAIL AS userEmail FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_NICKNAME = #{keyword} AND USER_KEY != #{myUserKey} AND USER_STATUS = 'S' LIMIT 1
SELECT USER_KEY AS userKey, USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, USER_EMAIL AS userEmail FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{keyword} AND USER_KEY != #{myUserKey} AND USER_STATUS = 'S' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FRIEND_MST ( FRIEND_KEY, REQUEST_USER_KEY, TARGET_USER_KEY, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{friendKey}, #{requestUserKey}, #{targetUserKey}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT F.FRIEND_KEY AS friendKey, F.REQUEST_USER_KEY AS requestUserKey, U.USER_NICKNAME AS requestUserNickname, U.USER_EMAIL AS requestUserEmail, F.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM TB_FRIEND_MST F JOIN TB_USER_MST U ON F.REQUEST_USER_KEY = U.USER_KEY WHERE F.TARGET_USER_KEY = #{myUserKey} AND F.STATUS = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT U.USER_KEY AS friendUserKey, U.USER_NICKNAME AS friendNickname, U.USER_EMAIL AS friendEmail, COALESCE(P.ONLINE_YN, 'N') AS onlineYn, P.CURRENT_ROOM_KEY AS currentRoomKey FROM TB_FRIEND_MST F JOIN TB_USER_MST U ON U.USER_KEY = CASE WHEN F.REQUEST_USER_KEY = #{myUserKey} THEN F.TARGET_USER_KEY ELSE F.REQUEST_USER_KEY END LEFT JOIN TB_CHAT_PRESENCE P ON P.USER_KEY = U.USER_KEY WHERE F.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( F.REQUEST_USER_KEY = #{myUserKey} OR F.TARGET_USER_KEY = #{myUserKey} ) ORDER BY COALESCE(P.ONLINE_YN, 'N') DESC, U.USER_NICKNAME ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_KEY = #{userKey} AND USER_STATUS = 'S'
